pages.text: In a small white circle, offer a Water Bucket, a sapling, Coquina, Sand, two Lapis Lazuli and a Toe of Frog. Coquina variants and both sand colors are accepted. This ritual changes weather in the Overworld.

After five seconds, the ritual starts rain for a random 3 to just under 10 minutes and returns one empty Bucket. It spends 250 startup and 20 per second: 350 total, or 312 with Hecate's Visage. It can also refresh existing rain.

A previous command-created clear-weather timer is removed so rain can begin. The ritual does not force a thunderstorm, override biome precipitation rules or change weather-cycle game rules. Toads now drop Toes of Frog, restoring this ingredient in survival.
